description: Script for updating GitHub pull request statuses and comments with documentation deployment links and status, based on deployment state and files changed.

classes.name: Settings
classes.description: Configuration class for GitHub repository, token, deployment URL, commit SHA, run ID, and deployment state.

classes.name: LinkData
classes.description: Data structure holding links related to documentation pages, including previous, preview, and optional English links.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that updates PR status, generates documentation links, and posts comments based on deployment status.
